page.notes: The scan shows only the front board of a book binding: blind-tooled leather or limp vellum-like cover with an embossed frame, arabesque and roll-and-circle ornament, and two brass or iron clasp fittings at the left edge. The embossed strapwork in the lower panel contains a few letter-like shapes, but they are decorative tooling and not legible printed text. No printed page, running head, page number or signature is visible, so nothing is transcribed.
